description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for handling article updates in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes request models, validation, and a handler class that performs the update logic, including updating article properties and tags, with database interactions using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: Edit.ArticleData
classes.description: Record representing the data of an article, including optional title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request command containing the article model and slug, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class for the Command, ensuring the article data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: The main request handler class that performs the logic to edit an article including database updates.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes the article update request, updating data and managing tags.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Static method to determine which new tags need to be created for the article.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Static method to determine which existing tags should be removed from the article.
